body:
Fictional Financial Standards Board (FFSB) has published notice FFSB-SN-2026-288 (Encryption of customer data at rest). It takes effect on 2 Oct 2026.

Can Compliance work out which patforms are in scope and whether we meet the new encryption requirement?
signature:
Zainab Mistry
Head of Function, Compliance
Harbourline Mutual Finance Ltd
subject: Notice FFSB-SN-2026-288 - please assess
